name: options
description: Selectable options. Prefer Dropdown when there are 6 or more options or when space is limited; for 5 or fewer options where all choices should stay visible at once, use a Radio group instead.

name: value
description: Controlled selected value. Use together with `onValueChange` when integrating with form libraries or when the selection needs to drive other UI. For simple uncontrolled usage, use `defaultValue` instead.

name: defaultValue
description: Initial selected value for uncontrolled usage.

name: onValueChange
description: Callback fired when the selected value changes. Pair with `value` for controlled usage.

name: placeholder
description: Text shown in the trigger when no option is selected. Default: 'Select an option'.

name: size
description: Size of the dropdown trigger. Default: 'medium'.

name: rounded
description: Corner radius of the dropdown trigger (small, medium, large). Default: 'medium'.

name: intent
description: Semantic color intent (primary, secondary, success, warning, danger, neutral). Default: 'primary'.

name: disabled
description: Whether the dropdown is disabled. Default: false.

name: side
description: Side of the trigger the popup appears on. Automatically flips to the opposite side when there is not enough space. Default: 'bottom'.

name: align
description: Alignment along the chosen side, relative to the trigger. Default: 'start'.

name: sideOffset
description: Gap in pixels between the trigger and the popup. Default: 4.
